description: Shared-module ownership for readiness type gates. Each path must be covered by every runtime that imports it.

modules.denoGate: deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json on edge entrypoints that import ../../../shared (and transitive)
modules.notes: Do not exclude shared/ production modules from either gate. Deno-only shared/**/*_test.ts files are excluded from browser tsc (naming convention) and covered by deno test/check. Browser tsc must not typecheck supabase/functions.

modules.denoGate: deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json on every functions/*/index.ts
modules.ideOnly: supabase/functions/tsconfig.json + deno-ambient.d.ts are IDE aids; they are not the backend type gate
